messages:
olivia: FYI: Hosted Toolcall Streaming (v2) is GA in hosted regions (us-east-1, eu-west-1) as of 09:00 PT. Docs and quick migration notes are live: https://console.redwood.ai/docs/hosted/toolcall-v2-ga. Please read if you manage SDKs, integrations, or customer comms :tada:

raj: Great news. Quick Q  any hard-breaking API changes?

olivia: Mostly opt-in flags and better streaming frames. v1 compatibility will remain for 60 days, but v2 enables incremental tool deltas, resumable streams, and explicit `end`/`error` frames. Minimal client edits required. Example to opt in:
```
POST /v1/generate?toolcall=stream_v2
{ "model":"cascade-xt-1", "stream":true }
```
Stream uses `data:` prefixed JSON lines. Full examples in the docs.

emily: Ops/SDK note: we added a new quota type `stream_sessions` and a per-connection idle timeout (120s). SDKs should support reconnect + resume tokens.

prod-marketing: Can you share a 1-liner we can use on the changelog and tweet?

olivia: Draft blurb: "Toolcall Streaming v2 GA: incremental tool outputs, resumable streams, and improved latency for interactive apps." Shorten as needed.

raj: Any known regressions to flag to Support?

olivia: Two small gotchas: 1) single-tool payloads >900KB may be buffered differently (runtime ticket filed), 2) some corporate proxies may drop long-lived connections; recommend keepalives. We'll proactively email customers over 75k tokens/mo.

ops-bot: Canary rollout: us-east-1 at 10% traffic. Monitors: stream_session_count, p95_latency, stream_disconnect_rate. Alerts to #eng-runtime.

emily: I'll open SDK PRs for Node/Python today and add parsing examples. Also scheduling an internal migration hands-on next Wed 11am PT.

olivia: Thanks team. I'll post the formal deprecation timeline in #announcements: v1 sunset in 60 days, full shutdown in 120 days. Ping me with any blocker reports. :rocket:
